narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I count the stones, five, six, seven, eight and nine, so it is five steps.
<bookmark mark='first'/>But Joseph already stands on stone five. No hop is needed to reach the stone he is on.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Count the hops between the stones, not the stones themselves, to find the distance.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>To find a distance on the number line, count the hops between the numbers, never the numbers themselves.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. From two, how far must you travel along the number line to reach seven?
